test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to substitute the underlined word in the following sentence.**

They realised that the ghost was **__imperturbable__**.
solution: The correct answer is **"excitable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Imperturbable"** means calm and unable to be easily excited or disturbed. (जो कठिन स्थिति में जल्‍दी विचलित नहीं होता; धीर, शांत, अविचलित) • **Example**: *He was **imperturbable**__ in a crisis.* • The antonym of **imperturbable** is** excitable.** • It means easily excited or agitated. (सहज उत्तेजित होने वाला; उत्तेजनशील) __ • **Example**: *She is an **excitable**__ person and gets nervous easily.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) Exasperating** means irritating or annoying, which is not the opposite of imperturbable. (क्रोधजनक, आवेशकर, क्षोभकारी) • **Option 2) Startling** means surprising or shocking, which is not the opposite of imperturbable. (चौंकाने वाला) • **Option 4) Contaminating** means polluting or infecting, which is not the opposite of imperturbable. (कोई पदार्थ डालकर किसी वस्‍तु को दूषित कर देना; संदूषित करना) 32:T819, Here, the erroneous part is **"on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy."**
